annotations.title: Get the full record of one of the NSW complying development certificates (CDCs) by its Planning Portal CDC number.

description: Get the full record of one of the NSW complying development certificates (CDCs) by its Planning Portal CDC number. Returns every location with lot and plan, all development types, submission, lodgement, determination and exhibition dates, cost, dwellings, storeys, lots and the remaining source fields. Take CDC numbers from search_applications or search_nearby_applications. An unknown number returns not_found and is not charged. Costs $0.005 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; clients without x402 support receive the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (NSW Planning Portal), CC BY 4.0.
